name: Spica
source:
“Ah, I'm here to protect them.
...Because I care for people living in the moment.”

Unit: Escort Red, 1st Squad
Rank: Space

Thanks to his defense-oriented ability, he was appointed in charge of the defense of H.A.Z.E.'s base of operations.

He possesses a gentle, androgynous disposition.
